svg.title: dev-cycle pipeline
svg.desc: The orchestrator dispatches six phases in order: discovery, spec, plan, implement, review and test gates, and git. Failed gates loop back to implement. State is kept in plain files.

text.font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

svg.text: DEV-CYCLE · FROM IDEA TO MERGED PULL REQUEST

text.font-family: Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif
Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: Never writes feature code. Interviews you, then dispatches one specialised skill per phase.

g.text: Bugfix and hotfix reuse the same gates. Hotfix branches from the latest release tag and cherry-picks forward to main.
